structure: Five day menu sheets paired with allergen-checker sheets and a weekly total sheet.
sourceObservations: Day sheets use PRODUCT/DISH headers and site columns with totals.
Site labels vary by sheet (for example ANGEL, angeel, comm, commerce, MK and BP).
Allergen sheets contain an ALLERGEN CHECKER layout and may-contain instruction text.
Source evidence must be reviewed before publication; no allergens are inferred from dish names.
